title: New SAP Incentive Management, Starter Edition, Now Available
summary: SAP Incentive Management, starter edition, offers core compensation management capabilities for growth-focused organizations. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Organizations are under increasing pressure to drive predictable growth while maintaining operational efficiency. Leaders are expected to motivate performance, improve visibility, and align compensation programs with business objectives across both revenue-generating and non-revenue-generating teams. At the same time, compensation teams are being asked to deliver greater accuracy, transparency, and agility, often with limited resources.


In this environment, incentive compensation has evolved well beyond commission calculations. It has become a critical tool for driving engagement, reinforcing desired behaviors, and building trust between sales teams, field teams, and leadership. And as business models evolve, so do the roles it supports. In addition to revenue generators, incentives are now used to manage KPI-based performance across a wide range of functions, including customer service, delivery, and warehousing.


For growing organizations, however, implementing and managing incentive compensation can be a challenge. Teams need reliable calculations, streamlined administration, and clear visibility into performance and earnings, along with a solution that is easy to deploy, adopt, and manage without added complexity.


Automate complex sales plans, gain real-time insights, and motivate sales teams


[Find out how](https://www.sap.com/products/crm/incentive-compensation-management.html)


SAP is introducing **SAP Incentive Management, starter edition** , a new offering designed for revenue leaders, total reward leaders, and compensation leaders with core compensation management capabilities for growth-focused organizations.


## **Building a foundation for a connected revenue operation**


As organizations scale, incentive compensation becomes increasingly connected to the broader revenue ecosystem. SAP Incentive Management, starter edition, helps establish that foundation by supporting the integration of data across the business and drawing from[ERP](https://news.sap.com/topics/erp/) , HCM, and SFA systems. By connecting information from operational systems, organizations can improve calculation accuracy, provide greater performance visibility, and support more informed decision-making.


The starter edition is equipped with core capabilities out-of-the-box that can provide a streamlined foundation for organizations seeking to modernize incentive compensation management while maintaining simplicity and ease of administration.


- **Dedicated mobile app access for sellers and revenue generators** with easy access to compensation information on the go
- **Payee portal** to help give sellers greater visibility into incentive compensation, earnings, and performance
- **Plan administration** to help simplify the management and maintenance of compensation
- **XDL integration capabilities** to support data exchange and connectivity
- **Embedded analytics** to help provide insights into compensation activities and performance outcomes


## **Delivering value across the revenue organization**


The impact of incentive compensation extends beyond compensation teams. When incentives are managed effectively, organizations can improve alignment, transparency, and operational efficiency across the revenue organization.


- **Revenue operations and compensation teams** can streamline plan administration, automate calculations, reduce manual effort, and gain insights through embedded analytics.
- **Sellers and revenue-generating teams** can gain greater visibility into earnings, performance metrics, and incentive opportunities through self-service access and mobile capabilities.
- **Sales managers and business leaders** can leverage compensation and performance insights to support coaching, forecasting, and strategic decision-making.
- **Business and IT stakeholders** can benefit from secure integration capabilities that connect compensation processes with existing business systems, helping create a scalable foundation for growth.


By providing a shared source of visibility across stakeholders, organizations can improve confidence in compensation processes while reducing administrative complexity.


Learn more about how SAP is helping organizations turn compensation into a strategic lever for high-impact growth with[SAP Incentive Management](https://www.sap.com/products/crm/incentive-compensation-management.html) .


---


Barbara Linning is global vice president for Product, Engineering, and Cloud Operations at SAP.
